description: Apps that intentionally do not adopt @nzila/platform-shell or @nzila/platform-auth. Each entry must have a justification, owner, and review date.

entries.justification: Fastify API server — no browser UI, no need for platform shell components. Uses API key auth instead.
Server-to-server API using ORCHESTRATOR_API_KEY. Session-based auth is not appropriate for headless API orchestration.
Public marketing site — uses a custom public layout, not the authenticated platform shell. No org-scoped context.
Client-facing portal with custom branding and layout distinct from internal platform shell. Uses platform-auth for identity but not the internal shell chrome.
Golden-path scaffold harness used for platform validation and contract checks. It intentionally validates auth and enforcement primitives without adopting the full internal shell UI.
